description: Refactor passenger-app from single MainScreen with drawer to industry-standard bottom tabs (Home, Activity, Payments, Notifications, Account). Currently uses Stack navigation with drawer-style MainScreen. Target: 5 bottom tabs matching Bolt/Uber patterns. Preserve all existing screens (Orders, Payment, Promo, Settings, Support, Profile, RideRequest, TripActive, Rating, Traffic) and wire them into appropriate tab stacks.
steps: Read apps/passenger-app/App.tsx and apps/passenger-app/screens/MainScreen.tsx to understand current navigation structure and drawer implementation

Create apps/passenger-app/navigation/MainTabNavigator.tsx with @react-navigation/bottom-tabs, defining 5 tabs: Home (home icon), Activity (list icon), Payments (wallet icon), Notifications (bell icon), Account (person icon)
Create apps/passenger-app/navigation/HomeStackNavigator.tsx - stack containing HomeScreen (new, replaces map view from MainScreen), RideRequestScreen, TripActiveScreen, RatingScreen, TrafficScreen

Create apps/passenger-app/screens/HomeScreen.tsx by extracting map, location, nearby drivers, and booking UI from MainScreen.tsx. Include 'Where to?' input, saved places, recent trips, refer & earn card, and services shortcuts

Create apps/passenger-app/screens/ActivityScreen.tsx for trip history with filters (All/Completed/Cancelled/Pending). Use existing OrdersScreen as reference. Fetch trips from /api/v1/trips endpoint and display with date groupings (Today/Yesterday)

Create apps/passenger-app/screens/PaymentsScreen.tsx showing payment methods (Cash, M-Pesa, Tigo Pesa, Airtel Money), transaction history, and 'Add payment method' button. Link to existing PaymentScreen for details

Create apps/passenger-app/screens/NotificationsScreen.tsx with notification list (driver updates, payment confirmations, booking changes, promos) and read/unread status. Mock data initially, prepared for push notification integration

Create apps/passenger-app/screens/AccountScreen.tsx by refactoring existing ProfileScreen content. Add sections: Edit Profile, Payments (link), Saved Places, Promo Codes (link to PromoScreen), Refer Friends, Safety, Language (existing i18n switcher), Notifications settings, Help & Support (link to SupportScreen), Legal, About, Logout
Update apps/passenger-app/App.tsx to replace Stack.Screen name='Main' with the new MainTabNavigator. Keep auth flow (CountryLanguage, Onboarding, Welcome, Login) and driver screens unchanged

Add i18n keys to apps/passenger-app/i18n/en.json and sw.json: tab_home, tab_activity, tab_payments, tab_notifications, tab_account, activity_title, payments_title, notifications_title, account_title, no_notifications, mark_all_read, add_payment_method, transaction_history, saved_places, refer_friends, legal_terms, about_app
Update apps/passenger-app/package.json to ensure @react-navigation/bottom-tabs is listed (already present per exploration)
acceptance_criteria: Passenger app displays 5 bottom tabs: Home, Activity, Payments, Notifications, Account
Home tab shows map, location, 'Where to?' input, saved places, recent trips, and ride booking flow works end-to-end
Activity tab displays trip history with filters and date groupings
Payments tab shows payment methods and transaction history
Notifications tab displays notifications list with read/unread states
Account tab provides access to all settings, profile, help, and logout
All existing screens (RideRequest, TripActive, Rating, Orders, Payment, Promo, Settings, Support, Profile, Traffic) are accessible from appropriate tabs
i18n works in both English and Swahili for all new navigation labels
No existing functionality is lost or broken
verification: Run: cd apps/passenger-app && npx expo start
Open in iOS Simulator or Android Emulator
Verify 5 bottom tabs appear and are tappable
Tap each tab and verify correct screen loads
From Home tab, tap 'Where to?' and verify RideRequestScreen opens
Navigate to Activity tab and verify trip history displays
Navigate to Payments tab and verify payment methods list
Navigate to Notifications tab and verify notifications list (mock data OK)
Navigate to Account tab and verify all menu items are present and tappable
Tap Settings in Account tab and verify SettingsScreen opens
Change language to Swahili and verify all tab labels and screen titles update
Change back to English and verify labels revert
